Messi was never just a player wearing Argentina’s shirt. He was the heart of an entire nation, the dream of millions of fans, and the man who carried the hopes of his people for so many years. 🇦🇷💔 The thought of Messi’s international retirement is heartbreaking, because we are not talking about an ordinary player. We are talking about a legend with whom we experienced the greatest moments and the most painful disappointments. From the tears of the 2014 World Cup final to the heartbreak of the Copa América, and from moments of doubt and criticism to the glory of Qatar in 2022, his journey with Argentina has been a story that will never be repeated. Messi returned every single time, despite the pain and pressure, until he finally achieved the dream he had chased throughout his career. He lifted the World Cup high above his head, giving Argentina a joy that history will never forget. And now, simply imagining a day when we will no longer see him wearing his national team shirt, or hear his name announced in the starting lineup, makes us feel that one of football’s greatest chapters is approaching its end. A day may come when Messi retires from international football, but no retirement can ever erase what this man has accomplished. His tears, his goals, his celebrations, and the moment he lifted the World Cup will forever remain engraved in the memories of every football fan. He gave Argentina glory, and he gave us memories that will live forever. Thank you, Leo, for never giving up, and for proving that dreams may be delayed, but they never truly die. And if this is the end, then let it be an ending worthy of the greatest player ever to wear the blue and white shirt. Argentina will always be your home, and you will forever remain its king. Thank you for everything, Leo Messi. 🐐💔 #messi
